E-Sys MAX 5.3.4

Improved
- Move to a new PC: the Move screen and its messages are now in every app language.
- Move to a new PC: the Move screen fits small and scaled screens (it scrolls).
- Move to a new PC: a move finishes cleanly even when the internet drops in the middle.
- Korean, Japanese, Chinese: E-Sys's own buttons show their whole text again.
- FA helper: Enter in the search box only searches.
- NCD editor: a damaged NCD file is named right away when it opens.
- Copy buttons, Open folder and Contact always answer the click.
- Many small fixes.

Your licence and settings stay the same after updating.

Thank you for using E-Sys MAX.
